     6: #include <math.h>
     7: #include <stdio.h>
     8: #include <stdlib.h>
     9: #include "ameutils.h"
    10: /* *******************************************************************************
    11: TITLE : TRANS0
    12:  
    13: ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    14: DESCRIPTION :
    15:  
    16:    Transfers some variables to one or several receiver submodels without any
    17:    visible connection on the sketch.
    18:  
    19:    A transmitter and a receiver behave as if the output of the transmitter was 
    20:    connected to the input of the receiver. As a result of this, the receiver 
    21:    output is actually a duplicate of the transmitter input.
    22:  
    23:    However this connection is not visible on the sketch since these two 
    24:    components are not directly connected and not linked by any line.
    25:  
    26: ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    27: USAGE :
    28:  
    29:    Use this submodel with one or several receivers when you want to transfer a 
    30:    signal without any visible connection on the sketch.
    31:  
    32:  
    33:    The association of a transmitter with a receiver is made using port tags. 
    34:    Each receiver having the same port tag as a given transmitter will have 
    35:    this transmitter input as output. A transmitter can be associated with one 
    36:    or several receivers.
    37:  
    38:    Assigning a port tag to a transmitter submodel is described in the AMESim 
    39:    manual.
    40:  
    41: ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    42: PARAMETER SETTINGS :
    43:  
    44: ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    45: REVISIONS :
    46:  
    47: --------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    48: SOURCE :
    49:    Siemens Industry Software SAS
    50:    7 place des Minimes
    51:    42300 Roanne - France
    52:    tel: (33).04.77.23.60.30
    53:    fax: (33).04.77.23.60.31
    54:    www.siemens.com/plm
    55: 
    56:    Copyright 2015 Siemens Industry Software NV
    57: ******************************************************************************* */
    58:
